rationale: PINS field-access Uses + the TSD1 write gate (JAD1 class, java wave). READS of fields emit uses from the method (inc's read-modify-write, read's const). WRITES (write() { this.value = 2 }) are assignment-LHS spans — they emit NO uses edge (pre-TSD1 the write method emitted uses value, a write-as-read defect that survived every gate; the java wave's write gate now reaches TS). The update expression in inc() (++ suffix) is a read-modify-write and KEPT its uses edge (java parity: update expressions are not gated).
